svg.text: What happens when a person asks for a risk assessment — from the button to the stored result. Red boxes are the answers the person sees when a step refuses; nothing is stored unless the prediction passes every check.
Monthly income, living costs, savings, credit score and a goal
Zod rules; a problem comes back as 422 with a message for each field,
Needed once before the first assessment. The 12 demo personas
already have a profile, so their assessment works straight away.

Work out 5 ratios; scale and one-hot encode; Gradient Boosting

A timeout or any other failure ends here too
Level, score, probabilities, model and target versions (target status:

Deterministic rules read the level, the top drivers and the person's own
figures; the same input always gives the same advice
Each recommendation keeps its rule id and its working (the trace)
Rules, not a language model — lib/risk/recommendation-rules.ts
Store the recommendations, read the record back
If saving fails at step 10 or 12: 500 STORAGE_FAILED — "Your
assessment could not be saved. Please try again."
The result on the Risk Assessment page
• Low / Medium / High, the 0–100 score and the three probabilities
• What drove it — the top drivers
• Recommendations, each with [Why this recommendation?] showing the working
• A warning when an input is unusual; the assessment history
Also on the page, nothing stored: What if things changed? (POST /predict + /what-if) · People in a similar position (POST /segment) · Payment
